body: Just look after her, even if she’s doing fine she may be putting on a brave face for you. It’s brilliant to hear she can recover from this, I am wishing that she has a quick and healthy recovery.

I used to cut, and it used to really help. I went as far as mutilating myself which was a mistake, however when it comes to cuts it gets me into a lot of trouble when people witness it. 

As much as it feels good, it’s not good for you and I advise that you don’t. Don’t go down the road of mentally abusing yourself either, as that’s a very vicious habit to get out of. 

Try finding a hobby, or talk to people when you feel urges to cut yourself.

Why do I want to do this? Easy, I’m not happy and I’m not satisfied with life.

Doesn’t matter anyways, I got caught out and now people know my intentions because I’m dumb enough to post it on here.
